snippet.title: Sporbs - Official Release Trailer - Out Now!
snippet.description:
Sporbs is now available on Steam - 30% Launch discount!

Harvest, upgrade, automate, and become more efficient.

The full version introduces new mechanics, unique organisms, expanded progression, 4 new original tracks (8 total), and a unique ending.

▸ ~2-3+ hours of gameplay
▸ 170+ upgrades
▸ 20 Steam achievements
▸ Original soundtrack

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4241840/Sporbs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=trailer&utm_content=narrated

Languages supported at launch:
English • French • German • Spanish • Japanese • Korean • Portuguese • Russian • Simplified Chinese
(More languages may be added based on community interest!)

Thank you to everyone who played the demo - being my first solo release, your feedback has helped me shape Sporbs into something I'm very proud of.

-
